xz.interpretation: Originally 2604 physical algorithm lines; this version modifies dict_repeat in the shared native/user XZ core. It is not a zero-body-edit port. Lines include comments/blanks and conditional paths; executed coverage requires runtime evidence and source size is not developer time.
xz.native_changes: XZ wrapper include redirects the public API to owner exports; native PREALLOC allocation semantics are retained. Kernel support binds nine private environment services.
xz.user_changes: Bind private allocator/memory/CRC services and select the common XZ SINGLE-mode API for complete contiguous compressed blocks; remove liblzma dependency.

lz4.source: Existing adapted Section 6.3 safe LZ4 decoder and header; retain the generic decoder plus safe entry, omit other API entries.
lz4.handwritten_changes: Rename exported safe entry, define/bind private memory-helper slots, redirect native wrapper and user dispatch, update export/build lists.
lz4.source_reuse_accounting: The assembled codec and header include reused code and generated binding additions. They are not new handwritten lines or an independent implementation.

interpretation: Native file changes include mechanical moves, renaming and service exposure. The filesystem-body count excludes new support, generators, wrappers and user adapters. XZ reuses the original 2604-line algorithm source extent but now changes dict_repeat; nine private service slots and six exported entry/binding symbols remain. Bounded private cache and explicit handle lifetime work are additional user-adapter maintenance. Neither physical lines nor changed function counts estimate developer hours.
